writing.task1Content: The given bar chart illustrates the proportions of households owning consumer electronics in 2020. Overall, high-income households demonstrated the highest ownership across all categories, whereas low-income groups showed significantly lower rates. Specifically, smart televisions and personal computers were prevalent in over eighty percent of affluent homes. In contrast, basic household appliances remained relatively consistent across income tiers.
writing.task2Content: The debate over whether higher education should be funded completely by the state or financed by individual students has gained considerable traction in recent decades. While critics claim that free tertiary education places an excessive burden on taxpayers, I firmly believe that universally accessible university education yields substantial long-term economic and social returns for nations. To begin with, free education ensures equality of opportunity for bright students from disadvantaged backgrounds.
